section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that through the soul illuminating the body, specifically where the choice of Atzmus resides, an elevation is added to the soul, and concludes with a prayer for the fulfillment of the prophecy of the resurrection and the coming of Moshiach.
section.t: And likewise is it also regarding Yisrael themselves,
that through the soul illuminating the body,
an elevation is added to the soul,
and analogous to the future era when the soul will be nourished from the body.
And may it be His will that very soon the prophecy be fulfilled,
"And they shall awaken and sing, you who dwell in the dust," and the master of the hillula among them,
and we will all go speedily, upright, to our land, with the coming of Moshiach Tzidkeinu,
speedily, in our very own time.
